espresso.$description: Espresso — Primary text, icons, card borders, nav, footer, input fields — the structural dark that holds every screen together, warm rather than black to stay on-brand with roasted coffee

burnt-orange.$description: Burnt Orange — Filled action buttons, active links, key highlights, badge fills — the single vivid accent that makes interactive elements feel switched on against the cream canvas

amber-ink.$description: Amber Ink — Secondary accent for emphasized text, hover states, and warm callouts — a slightly darker orange that pairs with Burnt Orange for tonal depth

marigold-wash.$description: Marigold Wash — Soft highlight backgrounds, tag fills, and decorative washes — used sparingly to add warm sunlight moments inside otherwise neutral layouts

dusty-blue.$description: Dusty Blue — Cool counter-accent for secondary buttons, link backgrounds, and color variety — the only blue in the system, it reads as a quiet companion to the warm palette

cream-paper.$description: Cream Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, button fills, input backgrounds — the base layer of every screen, warm off-white that replaces pure white

linen-beige.$description: Linen Beige — Card backgrounds, section surfaces, image borders, body borders — one step deeper than canvas, creates gentle layered surfaces without elevation

taupe-hairline.$description: Taupe Hairline — Hairline dividers, card borders, nav separators, subtle structural lines — the only border color most components need

sandstone.$description: Sandstone — Muted card backgrounds, soft surface fills, disabled surface states — a warm gray-taupe for low-emphasis panels

coffee-dust.$description: Coffee Dust — Muted body text, helper text, low-emphasis copy — warm brown-gray that fades into the cream without disappearing

little-amps.$description: Custom display serif for brand wordmark, section headlines, and large editorial titles. Heavy negative tracking (-0.10em) at 41–51px creates a tight, chunky retro-poster feel. The heaviest typographic element on every page and the signature voice of the brand.

inclusive-sans.$description: Primary body and UI text. Used for descriptions, paragraphs, and most readable content. Consistent 0.05em positive tracking gives a slightly looser, zine-like feel. The workhorse — appears in nearly every context.

necto-mono.$description: Labels, buttons, navigation, dates, prices, and all structural metadata. Tighter line-heights (0.80–1.20) and monospaced forms make it feel like stamped or typewriter-set type. 0.05em tracking is the system-wide small-caps standard.

roboto-mono.$description: Secondary monospaced text for code-like or technical labels, supplementing Necto Mono in body and data contexts.

gtstandard-m.$description: Rare body fallback — appears in minimal contexts.
